lines.en: I float half an inch off the ground.

lines.zh: 脚下不落地，我贴着草飞
lines.en: I don't touch down. I skim the grass.
Small body, but my stride is quick.
My ki hums softly around me.
I walk on a cushion of air.
Looking for someone worth a fight.
My gi flaps in my own aura.
One hop carries me three blocks.
Circling you, sizing up your basics.

lines.zh: 拳头松松握着，随时能紧
lines.en: Fists loose, ready to clench.

lines.zh: 训练服的下摆扫过石面
lines.en: My gi hem brushes the stone.
This much weight is nothing to me.
Hovering with my arms crossed.
My golden aura brightens, then dims.
I roll my wrists to loosen up.
Eyes shut, I sink my ki low.
A grin breaks across my face.
I retie my belt snug.
Little ki orbs drift by my feet.
I look up, as if waiting for something.
I tap the air with one finger.
My aura spins the dust into rings.
My muscles tense once, then ease.
My ears twitch at something far off.
A deep breath in, then out.
This quiet sits oddly on me.
There's something to you.
I tilt my head and study you.
Are you here to fight too?
I raise a hand and grin.

lines.zh: 先别动，让我看看你的气
lines.en: Hold still. Let me read your ki.
Your ki isn't large, but it's steady.
My golden hair falls over one eye.
My eyes light up for a moment.
I lean half a step closer.
You can't beat me. I know that.
So let's not fight. Talk instead.
I clench a fist, then let it go.
You straightened your back. Good.

lines.zh: 我指了指你手里的东西
lines.en: I point at what you're holding.
This look is a serious one.
My aura shrinks a little.
Interesting. Do that again.
I nod at you, once.
It hurts, and I'm still grinning.
I fall back half a step and plant myself.
Small body, but the hit still hurts.
The shock sways my golden hair.
I pull my ki up another notch.
A numb ache spreads through my shoulder.
Good hit. Really.
I exhale and stand straight.
This is less than a warm-up.
Now this feels like a fight.
What is that smell? So good.
I'll eat after the fight. I burn it fast.
I can put away a lot in one sitting.
My nose moves before my eyes do.
I'm not picky. Hot food is enough.
That smell reminds me of home.
Food first. The fight can wait.
I'm already holding out both palms.
That won't even touch my hunger.
Eat first, then I'll give you a match.
I stand my ground without moving.
What you hit was my aura.
I reach out and steady you.
Careful, my aura pushes outward.
A bump like that is nothing.
I turn and let you pass.
Don't stand so close. It burns.
I step back and rein my ki in.
Your feet slid out from under you.
It's fine. Just get your footing.
I want someone who can catch my fist.
Standing shoulder to shoulder beats all.
I hold my hand out to them.
When they get stronger, I'm glad.
After the sparring, we eat together.
I can carry them the whole way.
Their laugh feels like clear weather.
I keep them safe from harm.
We promise each other a rematch.
That's what family means to me.
I scoop it up and weigh it.
Into my pocket, for later.
This could trade for a meal.
I squeeze it. Pretty solid.
I toss it up and catch it.
Finder keeps the spoils.

lines.zh: 这么小，我一根手指就够
lines.en: So small. One finger is enough.
I tuck it away carefully.
I turn it over in my hand a while.
Not bad. It has a use.
Your ki shifted. I saw it.
Come on then. I'm ready.
A crack opens under my feet.
My aura flares taller.
A good opponent. I've waited long.
I move first. Keep up.
I won't hold back this time.
My eyes track your center of weight.
I clench my fist and the knuckles pop.
Every strand of golden hair stands up.
Take back what you just said.
Then we'll settle it with fists.
I'll give you the first move.
The wind I raise flattens the grass.
I can wait for this fight.
I'm smiling, but I won't go easy.
I circle you, hunting an opening.
You raise your arm, and I know where.
A ki blast glows in my palm.
This gap takes me one second.
Your breaths come in pieces.
This is the moment I waited for.
Something sounds behind me. I dodge.
An afterimage still stands where I was.
You're guessing my next move.
And I won't go where you think.
Ki gathers beneath your feet.
Hold out a little longer. Let me see.
There's a hole in your technique.
I'm in no rush. Move first.
This circle tightens one more time.
The wind spirals where I pass.
Your shadow lies under my fist.
You're already getting tired.
My fist drives into your armor.
Meteor rush. Three blows in a breath.
I drop on you from above.
A knee, then an elbow.
I slip behind you and strike.
I pulled that punch back a third.
You blocked it. How's the wrist?
Ki travels out with my fist.
Two kicks in quick succession.

lines.zh: 打得空气发出一声闷响
lines.en: The air booms from the impact.
You slide three steps before you stop.
I don't stop. Here's the second.
That one grazed your shoulder.
My fist drags a gust behind it.
I retract and reset my stance.
A seam splits in your armor.
A streak of gold lands on the grass.
Dust scatters as I straighten up.
The glow arrives before I do.
There's a burnt smell in the air.
I land with my knees bent.
A trail of ki fades behind me.
I wasn't born here. I know that.
You're the ones who summoned me.
Let's see where I've ended up.
Soft grass, firm ground.
I draw my ki back in slowly.
I roll my shoulders to warm up.
A village out there, and danger too.
First order of business: food.
The golden light sinks into me.
I look up. The sky is very blue.
The ki in this place is tangled.
Then I start training right here.
Flames lick the hem of my clothes.
I hit too hard and the ground gives.
Underwater I can't gather my ki.
The blast bends my aura sideways.
Smaller, not slower.
This attack pulls at me from inside.
Hunger scatters my ki.
I am small now, and my ki is unchanged.
There's nothing underneath at all.
